quests.title: A Name Worth Passing On
quests.text: Iron and jade, both orders filled; that is enough for me to put my name beside yours on a recommendation. Take my recommendation to Hadrin Beamset at the Miner's Guild house in Dur Brannoc; The Charter of Stone should know who helped us.
quests.completion: A foreman who recommends a helper is putting his own judgement on the page. I will remember your name at The Charter of Stone; reliable hands save a great deal of shouting.

quests.title: Clear the Haulers' Path
quests.text: Bracken Foxes keep stealing the food our haulers leave beside their packs, and hungry haulers are a poor investment. Hunt eight Bracken Foxes by day in the {name:lower_pines}, which lie {zone_area:lower_pines}. I have spent enough of this shift chasing my own lunch.

variants.text: Bracken Foxes keep stealing the food our haulers leave beside their packs, and hungry haulers are a poor investment. Hunt eight Bracken Foxes by day in the {name:lower_pines}, which lie {zone_area:lower_pines}. I have spent enough of this shift chasing my own lunch.

Rooters have been turning up the ground where our haulers wheel their loads through the orchards. Hunt eight Rooters by day in the {name:orchards}, which lie {zone_area:orchards}. If I wanted to push every cart myself, I would not have hired haulers.

Our haulers have enough roots to step over without Truffle Sows tearing up the ground around them. Hunt eight Truffle Sows by day in the {name:lower_boughs}, which lie {zone_area:lower_boughs}. I would like the next load to arrive with its carrier still upright.

Bog Seeps keep spreading across the fields our camp haulers use, and each crossing costs us another boot. Hunt eight Bog Seeps by day in the {name:blightfields}, which lie {zone_area:blightfields}. We keep names for the missing here; I refuse to start a register for footwear.

Cacklers have learned that a hauler with both hands full makes easy prey. Hunt eight Cacklers by day in the {name:grasslands}, which lie {zone_area:grasslands}. Our guards have enemies to watch, and I have loads to move.

Wallow Sows keep barging through the undergrowth and sending our porters scrambling with their loads. Hunt eight Wallow Sows by day in the {name:rainwood}, which lies {zone_area:rainwood}. The last porter saved the sack and landed in the mud; he has told me about it four times.

quests.notes: Round 58 camp hunt: one shared quest per camp band and clock, given by the camps' foremen; a role near the camp (the camps' level belt L11-13) that the zone's own quests do not hunt yet, met by day.
